en.topic_summary:
The Tourism Board should have consulted residents more before setting up light installations on a walking trail at The Peak, a lawmaker has said after the decorations were criticised as out of place.



The light installations at the Peak Circle Walk. Photo: Joe Lam, 西環變幻時.



Chan Hok-fung, who represents the Hong Kong Island West constituency, made the comments on an RTHK radio programme on Tuesday.
